description: This file contains utility functions for testing integration points within the openbb platform, including functions for dynamically loading test modules, verifying provider configurations, checking parameter correctness, and ensuring coverage of API endpoints through integration tests.

methods.name: List[Any] get_integration_tests( test_type: Literal["api", "python"], filter_charting_ext: Optional[bool] = True )
methods.description: Discovers and loads integration test modules for the specified test type ('api' or 'python') by scanning extension directories and dynamically importing test scripts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_module_functions(module_list: List[Any])
methods.description: Extracts all functions from a list of modules and returns a dictionary with function names as keys.

methods.name: List[str] check_missing_providers( command_params: Union[Dict[str, Dict[str, dict]], List[Tuple[Dict[str, str], str]]], function_params: List[dict], function, processing: bool = False, )
methods.description: Checks for missing providers in command and function parameters, reporting any absent providers required for tests.

methods.name: List[str] check_wrong_params( command_params: Union[Dict[str, Dict[str, dict]], List[Tuple[Dict[str, str], str]]], function_params: List[dict], function, processing: bool = False, )
methods.description: Verifies if the parameters passed to functions align with expected command parameters, reporting any incorrect ones.

methods.name: List[str] check_missing_params( command_params: Union[Dict[str, Dict[str, dict]], List[Tuple[Dict[str, str], str]]], function_params: List[dict], function, processing: bool = False, )
methods.description: Checks for missing required parameters in function calls based on command specifications.

methods.name: List[str] check_integration_tests( functions: Dict[str, Any], check_function: Callable[ [ Union[Dict[str, Dict[str, dict]], List[Tuple[Dict[str, str], str]]], List[dict], str, bool, ], List[str], ], )
methods.description: Verifies that all commands/routes have associated integration tests, reporting any missing.

methods.name: List[str] check_missing_integration_tests(test_type: Literal["api", "python"])
methods.description: Lists integration tests missing for each route in the specified test type ('api' or 'python').

methods.name: List[str] check_outdated_integration_tests(test_type: Literal["api", "python"])
methods.description: Detects and reports outdated or orphaned integration tests not matching current routes.

methods.name: List[str] check_missing_integration_test_providers(functions: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks whether all required providers are tested within the integration tests.

methods.name: List[str] check_missing_integration_test_params(functions: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Verifies that all required parameters are tested in the integration test functions.

methods.name: List[str] check_wrong_integration_test_params(functions: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if the parameters within integration tests match expected parameters, reporting discrepancies.
